items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I talk about Henry and Morton and Trump.

ctx.x: That's right. You can say you're doing the best you can. What was that place you were telling us about, a second of the magazine when Freddie and...
Martin? That was Henry and Morton. Now, they got there. I talk about Henry and Morton and Trump.
I'm done. I'm done. I'm done.
